extracted_concepts.name: Integers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Whole numbers including positive, negative, and zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimals
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numbers expressed in base ten with fractional parts separated by a decimal point.

extracted_concepts.name: Fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Numerical expression representing a part of a whole as a ratio of two integers.

extracted_concepts.name: Percentage
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratio or number expressed as a fraction of 100.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Comparison of two or more quantities indicating their relative sizes.

extracted_concepts.name: Standard form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scientific notation for expressing very large or small numbers as a coefficient times a power of ten.

extracted_concepts.name: Significant figures
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Digits in a number that carry meaningful information about its precision.

extracted_concepts.name: Bounds of accuracy
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Upper and lower limits defining the possible range of a rounded or measured value.

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical phrases combining variables, constants, and operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations forming straight lines when graphed, typically of the form ax + b = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Simultaneous linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of linear equations solved together to find common variable values.

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Polynomial equations of degree two, typically ax² + bx + c = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequalities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mathematical statements comparing values that are not equal.

extracted_concepts.name: Sequences
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ordered list of numbers following a specific arithmetic or geometric pattern.

extracted_concepts.name: Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relation mapping each input value to exactly one output value.

extracted_concepts.name: Cartesian coordinate system
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Plane defined by perpendicular horizontal and vertical axes for plotting points.

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measure of the steepness or slope of a line.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation of a straight line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Formula relating x and y coordinates, commonly y = mx + c.

extracted_concepts.name: Parallel lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines in a plane that maintain constant distance and never intersect.

extracted_concepts.name: Perpendicular lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that intersect at a right angle (90 degrees).

extracted_concepts.name: Midpoint
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Point exactly halfway between the endpoints of a line segment.

extracted_concepts.name: Distance between points
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Length of the straight line segment connecting two coordinates in space.

extracted_concepts.name: Surface area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Total area covering the outer surface of a three-dimensional shape.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Amount of three-dimensional space occupied by an object.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Curved distance along the circumference of a circle between two points.

extracted_concepts.name: Sector area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Area enclosed by two radii and the intercepted arc of a circle.

extracted_concepts.name: Density
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mass per unit volume of a substance.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle theorems
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric rules governing angles, chords, tangents, and arcs within circles.

extracted_concepts.name: Similarity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Property of geometric figures having identical shapes but potentially different sizes.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Property of geometric figures being identical in both shape and size.
